rows.en:
Oh dear… It seems DARK is finished?

Professor Gill… you are done for.
Wh-what are you saying!? My DARK, my New DARK Destruction Squad…

…………

Professor Gill… To tell you the truth, the story that Shadow was planning to assassinate you was a bald-faced lie.

Shadow merely hired Waruder to deal with Zero-One… They never betrayed you.
Wh-what!? Curse you!! You set me up!

Until today, we of Naager have helped you invade Earth free of charge…

But we do not have so much time on our hands that we would save the weak. Organizations without power must disappear…

Heh heh heh… Though even without our meddling, you were doomed to perish sooner or later…
You Kikaiders who have tormented DARK so… Now, at last, learn the true terror of DARK!
Ha ha ha… This DARK base has a self-destruct device! Die with meee!!
Professor Gill! What a monster…
He was a terrifying enemy… but DARK has finally been destroyed!

…!?

That flute!?

This humble one is but a worthless killer, hired by Shadow and sent to take your life, Sir Zero-One…

Have at you! Let us duel fairly!
Now then, Sir Zero-One…

I don't know what you are…

but if you're an assassin from Shadow, I can't let you go!! Here I come, Waruder!!
Have at you!
Woof, woof!!
What's wrong!? Waruder?
Waruder, someone like you… Why? Afraid of a dog?

D-dogs… though they are animals, they possess a heart that tells good from evil.

They bark at the wicked! They bite thieves… That is what this humble one… fears.

This humble one does not possess even so much heart as that dog. That angers me… and frightens me beyond bearing.
Waruder…

Sir Zero-One, Lady Bijinder… Though this humble one is Shadow's hired killer, I will never stoop to cowardly conduct.

When the time comes for us to cross swords, I shall surely write you a letter and challenge you to a fair and square duel… Farewell!
Waruderrr!!
It's yummy, huh?
Masaru! Don't eat too much.

Okay…

But… even a parfait this yummy, Jiro can't eat it, can he?

Ha ha ha…

Androids are strong! They don't age, either…

But you know… that doesn't necessarily mean they're happy.
Hmm…
So… Dr. Komyoji, will you be continuing your robotics research from now on?

Well, no…

I've come to realize that in today's world, creating androids that are too capable will only lead to them being misused…
Then…

We're going abroad!

Dad bought a house in Switzerland! For us…
Switzerland?

Actually, I had thought of taking the children abroad to relax for a while…

but Ichiro and Jiro taught me otherwise…

Jiro told me: "I don't want to become a perfect machine."

And he said he'll gain a strong spirit that won't lose to his incomplete Conscience Circuit, and keep fighting to protect humanity's freedom and peace…
Jiro said that?

Mitsuko…

Ichiro, Jiro… and Mari too… rather than becoming perfect androids, what they really want is to be human, even if imperfect.
That's why Jiro doesn't want a complete Conscience Circuit.

That's right…

It seems Jiro has learned much more than I thought. Being in this shop… I can see that clearly.

Mr. Tachibana… I too want to be of help to Ichiro, Jiro and everyone here…
Dr. Komyoji…
Father…
Mm… I've decided to join the TDF science group too.

Eh…

Um… then… what about my Switzerland?

What are you talking about, Hanpen! Everyone's fighting for peace, aren't they!

Don't you think it'd be shameful for just us to go abroad?

No, but, see here! We can leave the fighting to Mister Jiro…

Haaah, boo hoo hoo…

Oh? There's another one over there holding his head in his hands.

What's the matter, [HERO2]?
Take a look at this…
…What's this? An invitation to something?
It's an invitation… to a thing called a birthday, I'm told.
Why would that have you worried?

There are 2 invitations…

Aki Sakata and Rumi Sahara are both having birthday parties on the same day, at the same time.
…is what I'm thinking, anyway.

Oh? There's another one over there holding his head in his hands.

What's the matter, [HERO2]?
It's a birthday party invitation.

There are 2 invitations…

Aki Sakata and Rumi Sahara are both having birthday parties on the same day, at the same time.
…is what I'm thinking, anyway.
Aki is Go from MAT's girlfriend… and Rumi is Dr. Sahara's daughter. That sure is a big problem.
[HERO2], which birthday party are you going to?
Go to Aki Sakata's birthday party / Go to Rumi Sahara's birthday party / Don't go to either

Hmm… Well, you think it over carefully, then.

Still, today's a happy day! I'm so glad Dr. Komyoji is safe…
No need to worry anymore… From now on, we'll always be together.
Yeah!
DARK had been destroyed… They had succeeded in shattering its ambition to stain the Earth with evil. But that was only the prelude to a darkness that would summon an even greater evil…
Is everyone all right!?
New DARK Destruction Squad! We won't let you do as you please!
Hold out until Hakaider goes for his brain's blood exchange, and defeat the entire New DARK Destruction Squad!
Defeat the entire New DARK Destruction Squad!
Hurry to DARK's base to save Dr. Komyoji!!
Defeat White Eagle Musasabi and the entire New DARK Destruction Squad!
Jiro or Ichiro is defeated, or Hakaider is destroyed
<c3>Kotaro Minami</c>'s HP went down!
Uaaaaah!!
Your anger is only natural, Lord Creation King! Please, calm yourself!
If we cannot defeat Kamen Rider BLACK before the Century King awakens, the three of us must take responsibility… is that it?
Please, hear us out…
Our failures so far… are entirely due to the spinelessness of the monsters!

The monsters he defeated let their animal natures show too much, lost their composure…

and ignored the strategies we gave them!
Guoooh…
What!? You want us to break Birugenia's seal?
He is… an exceedingly dangerous man! Please, anything but that… Guoaaaah!!
Archpriest Baraom!!
Ugh… If it is Lord Creation King's command, it cannot be helped.
If at all possible… I never wanted to come near this coffin!

uncertain: U08341: Atefarina tells Gill the Shadow assassination plot was a lie (contradicting B0102); translated as given.
U08347: Jiro's 恐ろしい敵 refers to Gill; "He".
U08355: なぜ? 犬なんかに? — Waruder flinching from a stray dog; rendered "Afraid of a dog?" (verb inferred from U08356).
U08358: ビジンダー殿 rendered "Lady Bijinder".
U08379: ハンペン is Masaru's nickname for Hanpei Hattori, kept as "Hanpen".
U08381/U08388: もうひとり頭を抱えてる奴 — [HERO2] referred to as "his" (male hero route).
U08384/U08387/U08391: [HERO4]/[HERO2] variant lines; U08387/U08391 seem to follow a missing line, kept as fragments.
U08392: 郷さん rendered "Go"; アキさん "Aki".
U08394: player choice with three options joined with " / ".
U08401: [ja] — Hakaider needs a blood exchange for the brain; literal.
